studies.Journal: The American journal of clinical nutrition
studies.Population: Men participating in the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian Cancer (PLCO) Screening Trial
studies.comparison_type: Dietary phylloquinone intake modeled in quintiles or per IQR increase; DQX or DHQ assessment

extraction_supporting_text.effect_size: After adjustment for confounders, dietary intakes of phylloquinone, menaquinones, and total vitamin K, assessed with either the DQX or DHQ, were not significantly associated with the risk of advanced, nonadvanced, and total prostate cancer.
extraction_supporting_text.cases: During a median follow-up of 11.8 y, 2978 cases of prostate cancer (including 490 advanced cases) were identified from the 28,356 men who completed DQX. Similarly, 2973 cases of prostate cancer (including 647 advanced cases) were documented from the 48,090 men who completed DHQ.
